name: Tulsa Public Schools
districtFact: Tulsa Public Schools publishes a family calendar, a more detailed teacher calendar and a live district calendar. Together they show Pre-K assessment days and a separate first full day, 168 student days across four quarters and a weather-dependent May ending that can move from May 25 through May 28.

about.title: Three Official Calendars, Three Jobs
about.content: The printable family calendar is the clearest source for districtwide closures. The teacher calendar adds quarter day counts and the weather-day formula. The live calendar carries dated district events, while TPS's July 9 Pre-K notice explains the assessment and first full day.

about.title: The May 28 Ending Is Conditional
about.content: TPS builds three weather days into the published May 28 last day. The teacher calendar shows May 25, 26, 27 or 28 as the student ending, depending on how many weather days are used.

about.title: Quarter Dates Do Not Always Mean Classes
about.content: Quarter 2 begins October 13 on the teacher calendar, but October 13 is also a fall conference day with no classes. The date marks the new grading period, not a student attendance day.

calendarNotes: Use the printable family calendar for districtwide student closures, the teacher calendar for quarter counts and the weather-day ending rule, and the live district calendar for dated updates such as the separate Pre-K first day. Conference dates are no-class days, but schools provide exact meeting times. The Spanish family PDF is an official companion translation; its spring-conference event list says March 19 even though its legend and highlighted date, the English family calendar and the teacher calendar all show January 19. This site uses January 19 and discloses that source conflict on the 2026–27 page.

planningTips.title: Planning Around the TPS Calendar
content: Most students begin August 19, 2026. Pre-K students attend a short assessment with a parent or guardian on August 19 or 20, then have their first full day on August 21.
Keep May 25–28 flexible until TPS confirms how many weather days were used.
October 13 and January 19 are no-class conference days, but appointment times come from each school.
Use the live district calendar and school messages for building events and changes made after the printable PDF.

districtFaqs.q: Do all Tulsa Public Schools students start on August 19, 2026?
districtFaqs.a: No. Most students start August 19. Pre-K students attend a short assessment with a parent or guardian on August 19 or 20, and their first full day is August 21. Each school schedules its Pre-K assessment appointments.

districtFaqs.q: Is May 28, 2027, the fixed last day for Tulsa students?
districtFaqs.a: It is the published last day when all three built-in weather days are used. The TPS teacher calendar shows May 25 with zero weather days, May 26 with one, May 27 with two and May 28 with three.

districtFaqs.q: Are the TPS parent-teacher conference dates no-school days?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. The family calendar lists October 13, 2026, and January 19, 2027, as no-class conference days. Families should check with their school for exact conference dates and times.

districtFaqs.q: Why does the Spanish TPS calendar also list March 19 for spring conferences?
districtFaqs.a: January 19 has stronger support across TPS sources. It appears in the English family calendar, the teacher calendar and the Spanish PDF's own legend and highlighted date. March 19 appears only in the Spanish event list, so we use January 19 here.
